capabilities: Add a date-backlinks Base embed to the daily notes template
Show the view automatically below existing daily notes
Match date, date-time, and list date properties against the daily note date
Roll up matching notes by week or month with Pro
Narrow the generated query with folder filters and date ranges
disambiguation: Not traditional backlinks; it matches date properties through a Bases query and writes no link properties into the matching notes.
extras: Freemium: week/month rollups, extra properties and ranges need Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors, one payment covers all NoteMods plugins). After updates the plugin opens a 'What's new' tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; it sends no note data or telemetry and sign-in uses the GitHub device flow. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+.
intentEvidence: The core Bases plugin must be enabled in the vault.
problem: Core Bases filters and Dataview queries require writing manual queries to see which notes share a daily note's date inside that daily note.

relations.evidence: The core Bases plugin must be enabled in the vault.
Choose a template in core Daily notes or Periodic Notes.
Date Linker writes daily note links into a managed frontmatter property.
Why use this instead of Dataview or a plain Bases filter?

summary: Bases view that lists notes whose date properties match the current daily note's date, embedded in daily notes via a template or automatically.
